info.name: DSP Film Manager — Lab05
info.description: Manual REST verification for the Lab05 exclusive active-film selection surface (owner/reviewer setup, login, films-to-review, select/idempotent-reselect/replace/clear active film, second-user 409 conflict and its body/side-effect guarantees, authorization/validation, public/private film creation and deletion, logout). This collection exercises REST endpoints only, over a single shared Postman cookie jar (matching postman/lab04/lab04.postman_collection.json's convention: log in as one user, act, log out, log in as the next). It does NOT verify: retained MQTT delivery, late-subscriber behavior, QoS, broker restart/reconnect, MQTT gateway cleanup, true simultaneous concurrency, or WebSocket/MQTT cross-transport delivery — those are covered exclusively by the automated Node test suites (npm run test:lab05 and npm run test:lab05:integration, the latter against a real local Mosquitto broker). To manually observe the MQTT channel as a supplemental check, connect any MQTT client to a broker at mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883 (see shared-services/lab05/broker/mosquitto.conf) and subscribe to the numeric film-id topics used below while running these requests.

exec: pm.test('Runner starts without an active session', () => pm.expect([204, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('Alice login status is exactly 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Invite Karen to film 1 (idempotent: 201 first run, 409 on repeat Runner passes)

exec: pm.test('invitation status is 201 (created) or 409 (already exists from a previous Runner pass)', () => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
console.log('This makes the collection safely re-runnable: Karen only needs to be invited to film 1 once, ever.');
pm.test('Frank login status is exactly 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('session cookie exists after login', () => pm.expect(pm.cookies.has('connect.sid'), 'Missing connect.sid: enable the Postman cookie jar for this run').to.eql(true));
pm.test('response is a paginated film collection', () => pm.expect(page).to.include.key('films'));
pm.test('Frank is assigned to the shared film', () => pm.expect(filmIds).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('filmIdShared')));

item.name: 3. Select Active Film and Idempotent Reselect (Frank)
Frank selects the shared film as active

exec: pm.test('review is now active for the shared film', () => { pm.expect(review.active).to.eql(true); pm.expect(String(review.filmId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('filmIdShared')); pm.expect(review.reviewerId).to.eql(2); });

item.name: Frank reselects the SAME film (idempotent — still 200, not an error)

exec: pm.test('idempotent reselect status is 200 (not 409 — a user re-selecting their OWN already-active film is not a conflict)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('review remains active for the shared film', () => { pm.expect(review.active).to.eql(true); pm.expect(String(review.filmId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('filmIdShared')); });
pm.test('Karen login status is exactly 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const user = pm.response.json(); pm.test('authenticated user is Karen', () => pm.expect(user.id).to.eql(3));

item.name: Karen establishes her OWN active film first (film 1)

exec: pm.test('Karen selecting her own film status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Karen's own review is now active", () => { pm.expect(review.active).to.eql(true); pm.expect(review.reviewerId).to.eql(3); });
console.log('This establishes a distinct prior active film for Karen, so the conflict step below can prove it is left untouched.');

item.name: Karen attempts the film Frank already has active -> 409

exec: pm.test('409 body follows the project error convention ({ error: string })', () => pm.expect(body).to.have.property('error').that.is.a('string'));
pm.test("the 409 body must not name the current holder ('Frank')", () => pm.expect(body.error.toLowerCase()).to.not.include('frank'));

item.name: Verify the shared film is still active for Frank (public reviews)

exec: pm.test("Frank's active selection is unaffected by Karen's failed conflicting request", () => { pm.expect(frankReview, 'Frank review not found').to.exist; pm.expect(frankReview.active).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Karen's own state on the CONTESTED film remains unchanged (still inactive there)", () => { pm.expect(karenReviewOnSharedFilm, 'Karen review not found').to.exist; pm.expect(karenReviewOnSharedFilm.active).to.eql(false); });

item.name: Verify Karen's own previous film remains active

exec: pm.test("Karen's previously-established active film remains active after her failed attempt elsewhere", () => { pm.expect(karenReview, 'Karen review not found').to.exist; pm.expect(karenReview.active).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Karen clears her active film (so folder 5 can freely reuse film 1)

exec: pm.test('clear active film status is 204', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('Frank login status is exactly 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Frank replaces the shared film with film 1 (Karen no longer holds either)

exec: pm.test('review is now active for film 1', () => { pm.expect(review.active).to.eql(true); pm.expect(String(review.filmId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('filmIdKarensOwn')); });

item.name: Verify the replaced (shared) film is now inactive

exec: pm.test('the replaced film must no longer be active for Frank', () => { pm.expect(frankReview, 'Frank review not found').to.exist; pm.expect(frankReview.active).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('clear active film status is 204', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));

item.name: Verify no active film remains for Frank

exec: pm.test('Frank has no active film after clearing', () => { pm.expect(frankReview, 'Frank review not found').to.exist; pm.expect(frankReview.active).to.eql(false); });

item.name: Login Alice (owner, not a reviewer of the shared film)

exec: pm.test('Alice login status is exactly 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('unassigned reviewer selection returns 403 (not 409 — authorization takes precedence over the conflict check)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test('Alice login status is exactly 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Create a public film (own topic; publishes retained 'inactive' over MQTT — not verified here)

exec: pm.test('public film creation status is 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test('created film is public and has an id', () => { pm.expect(film.private).to.eql(false); pm.expect(film.id).to.be.a('number'); });

item.name: Create a private film (never published over MQTT — no topic exists for it)

exec: pm.test('private film creation status is 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test('created film is private and has an id', () => { pm.expect(film.private).to.eql(true); pm.expect(film.id).to.be.a('number'); });

item.name: Delete the created public film (isolated cleanup — never touches seed data)
